ToothCare Hub

Phase 2: Docker Environment

Containerized Environment & Reverse Proxy

Phase 2 establishes the isolated multi-service Docker topology for ToothCare Hub. All web traffic enters via Nginx on edge port 8080 (or 80/443 in production). Nginx routes API calls to php-fpm:9000, WebSocket streams to realtime:4000, and serves static React SPA assets with client-side fallback.

Nginx Proxy Active

Edge reverse proxy terminating public HTTP traffic and enforcing security headers.

Backend REST API PHP-FPM 8.5

Native PHP REST engine running on private FastCGI port 9000 with MySQL PDO connection.

Realtime Service Socket.IO 4.8

Node.js event engine handling real-time clinic updates and appointment notifications.
